## Call Type Selection

The **Spec** recommends semantic usage:
- **Page** and **Screen** calls describe the page/context itself (not user or actions)
- **Track** calls describe user events or activities

Page calls automatically include UTM campaign capture data.

## Implementation Strategy

Don't build a full implementation using only Track calls — this forces you to manually duplicate page-context data in every Track event.

**Better approach:** Pair Page + Track calls together. Using semantic methods reduces the information required per call and simplifies implementation complexity.

## Destination Compatibility

Different downstream tools handle call types very differently:

- **Some destinations don't accept Page and Screen calls at all** — they only work with Track
- **Destinations that accept Page/Screen calls** typically expect a limited data range; Track call data may not be properly received or handled in Page calls
- Segment uses call type to translate data into each destination's native tracking format — semantic method usage ensures highest compatibility

Reference: Segment maintains a [destination method compatibility list](/docs/segment/connections/destinations/methods-compare/) showing which calls each destination accepts.

## Data Organization

Using semantic methods separates "types" of information in downstream tools/warehouses, enabling different purposes (page analytics vs. event analytics, etc.).
